name: Hirasaka Yuki
source:
“Sorry if I'm a kid, but calling me like that is unpleasant”
“I can hear everything.”

A middle schooler who lives in Okunezato and is widely recognized as a genius.

He’s quick-witted and silver-tongued, making him seem cheeky at first. However, the locals warmly regard him as their hope for the future.

Although he’s just in his first year of middle school, he was elected student council president and has read every book in the library.

During his summer vacation, he’s helping out at the short-staffed Fuurinkan Hotel. He wants to grow up as fast as he can, and he absolutely loathes being treated like a child.
